outcome: infant gut microbiome composition (Bifidobacterium spp., Bifidobacterium longum)
cohort: Forty vaginally born twins from pregnancies beyond 36 weeks of gestation (mean gestational age 37.07 weeks) were included in the study.
finding: Significant differences were observed in the gut microbiome and its evolution between first and second vaginally born twins within the first 28 days of life, influenced by the duration of membrane rupture and the number of vaginal examinations.
